posts.title: General William Lee Davidson: Among the Best of the Best
posts.description: General William Lee Davidson, though rarely heralded, was one of America’s most outstanding military leaders of the American Revolution. A commander of Continental regiments that fought alongside General Washington, he led North Carolina’s militia when it was at its lowest ebb.
